scenario.goal_zh: 检查宽度和门的开启空间，确认符合约定要求并在验收单上签名

context_zh: 虚构家具送货场景中，顾客检查定制架子后完成签收。
author: author-phase09-a

sentences.speaker: April
sentences.text: Before I sign, can we check that the shelf is exactly eighty centimetres wide?

sentences.speaker: Lewis
sentences.text: Here is the tape measure. It shows eighty, as ordered.

sentences.speaker: April
sentences.text: And the cupboard door opens fully beside it. That was my other concern.

sentences.speaker: Lewis
sentences.text: Does it satisfy the requirements we agreed on?

sentences.speaker: April
sentences.text: Yes. I am satisfied with the size and the finish.

sentences.speaker: Lewis
sentences.text: Then I need your signature on this delivery inspection form, beside today's date.

sentences.speaker: April
sentences.text: Here you are. I have signed it after the width check.

sentences.speaker: Lewis
sentences.text: Thank you. This copy is yours.
